title: Coordinate switching failure indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a Boolean function on $n$ sign coordinates, let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, and assign each coordinate one of the statuses free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. The coordinate switching failure indicator is $1$ if the decision-tree depth of the resulting restricted function is at least $k$, and is $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ sign coordinates
a restriction status is assigned to every coordinate
caveat: The formal statement relies on the omitted definition of decision-tree depth.
